title: You're using AI wrong: the 4-part prompt

segments.say: Day one. The four-part prompt that fixes it.
segments.show: Day 01. The 4-part prompt that fixes it.

segments.say: Most people type: write me a cover letter. And get something generic.
Four parts. Role: senior tech recruiter. Task: cover letter, frontend role at Flipkart. Context: two years in sales, three React projects. Format: under one-fifty words, confident.
segments.show: 4 parts. Role: senior tech recruiter. Task: cover letter, frontend role at Flipkart. Context: 2 years in sales, 3 React projects. Format: under 150 words, confident.

segments.say: Same AI. Before: generic. After: specific, confident, human.
Role, task, context, format. Save this.
Tomorrow, day two: make AI write exactly like you. Follow so you don't miss it.
